title: Dereth Town Tour - Merwart Village scratch

shots.standingOrder: Hover over the sea looking down at the shallows, then tilt up to reveal the slime cliff and the two giant Merwart lodges beyond; stay 10 m above the water and the cliff top.
shots.notes: WATER ESTABLISHING. Hovers 32 m over the shallow sea north of Vissidal (WBT terrain type 18 WaterShallowSea, z 0 under the whole move) looking straight down at the water, drifts 18 m south while tilting up to -5 deg to reveal the beach, the 20 m slime-covered cliff and the two giant cone lodges of Merwart Village 200 m beyond (lodge tips z 57.6 / 47.6). Noon sun. Verified: AGL 32 throughout, nearest scenery 21.6 m (a low retail shore plant), the cliff top (z 18-26) stays 6+ m below the lens; line of sight to lodge A clear. vmax 2.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Frame the two giant cone lodges side by side from the sunlit east and drift slowly round them; keep 4 m from every rock and plant.
shots.notes: LANDMARK TWO-SHOT. The two giant Merwart cone lodges (0x01003D13, 16 m wide x 34 m tall) framed as a pair from the sunlit east-north-east: lodge B on the lower market terrace (38676, 43644, z 14) and lodge A on the upper terrace (38652, 43692, z 24), the slime cliffs and sea horizon beyond; a 10 deg drift. Camera z 43.7 (AGL 17.7 -> 21.6) on the plateau by the Life Stone. Verified: >= 14.5 m from all scenery, 60+ m from both lodges, LOS clear.

shots.standingOrder: Push slowly in on the sparkling Life Stone with the open plateau and the sea horizon behind it; stop 4 m short of the stone and the shore rocks.
shots.notes: FX: LIFE STONE. Perceptual push-in (WS -> FS, fov 40) from the east-south-east on the Merwart Life Stone (38725.8, 43715.4, z 26) - its sparkle column against the open slime plateau and the sea horizon to the north-west, noon sun. Verified: camera (38734.6, 43710.3, 28.9) -> (38729.9, 43713.1, 28.2), ground 26.0 (WBT), AGL 2.2-2.9, ends 4.6 m from the stone, 4.9 m from the 3 m shore rock 0x020014AF; no statics within 30 m.

shots.standingOrder: Corkscrew up around the tall cone lodge from its doorway to above its tip; keep 8 m from the lodge wall and 5 m above its peak at the top.
shots.notes: HERO DRONE MOVE. Helix around lodge A (38652, 43692, z 24): starts 24 m south-south-west at z 30 looking up at its south doorway, climbs counter-clockwise 0.4 rev past the market terrace and lodge B while the radius opens to 34 m, finishing 10 m above the lodge's 34 m tip (z 68) east-north-east of it, looking down over both lodges, the market and the sand flats. Verified against the lodge mesh: >= 11.6 m from the lodge surface, >= 11.8 m from scenery, AGL 9.2 -> 42.3, vmax 8.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Rise on the jib from behind the glowing smithy forge up past the doorway of the near cone lodge to look over the market terrace; keep 4 m from the stalls and barrels.
shots.notes: FX: FORGE + CLOSER. Jib rise from 2.2 m above the open-air market (38640.7, 43639.9) behind Blacksmith Bulidurg's outdoor forge - glowing coals 0x02000354 with firelight and a fire script, 10.4 m ahead at frame lower right - up 12 m past the dark doorway of lodge B (aim at its west door) to look over the market terrace; sun overhead. Verified: AGL 2.2 -> 14, nearest static the barrel stack 5.2 m north, stalls/doors 7+ m, scenery 4.8 m (retail) / 7.3 m (default); forge in frame at the start (15 deg right, 17 deg below centre).
